text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from my outing with
Gold City...
Hiyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Booom!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wha... What was that explosion?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Five more sets!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami?! Are you okay? I just heard a
loud
noise...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was the sound of me doing
yoga!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yoga?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I heard yoga makes you more
beautiful!
Sooo...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Menko pose!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thunk! Flap, flap, flap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Kawakami Princess slams a menko
card onto
the ground, all the birds in the
area take off at
once!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What am I watching...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Yoga really makes you work up a
sweat.
Care to join, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Shush! Trainer, look down by her feet.
choice_data_list: No, that's less like yoga and more...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At the feet of Kawakami Princess lies an
open
notebook.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's a lot of freaking notes. She
must've put a ton of
"research" into
coming up with that pose.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Telling her it's not yoga might crush her
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Telling her it's not yoga might crush her
motivation.
choice_data_list: I don't think that's quite the sam...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thanks.
choice_data_list: I don't think that's quite the sam...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing. I just never heard of the
menko pose
before.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You must have studied a lot. Can you
teach me
too?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Of course I can!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Mhm, mhm. So, that's the pigeon pose...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I see, then let's combine it with my
rice-washing
pose to make a new one!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. But if pigeons washed rice,
wouldn't their
wings get all soaked?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds so sad. Okay, I'll just
have to
learn the pigeon pose as it is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City succeeds in teaching Kawakami
Princess the correct
knowledge while maintaining
the guise
of being her student.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Phew... I guess that worked out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for keeping quiet and watching
us,
Trainer. I knew you'd understand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City smiles in relief.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-it isn't?! Huh? Oh, how embarrassing!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But don't feel discouraged. The work
you were
doing is still valuable.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you're right! I'm glad you were here
to point
out my mistakes!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, she bounced back quick.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I began to learn how to do
true yoga
from City.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes east, sometimes west,
through
unbeaten paths we dashed...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: W-wait, what's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I thought it would make me feel like I've
learned
something if I added some
narration.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh... We're not in some cartoon, you know.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Anyway, if it's okay with you,
City, could
you teach me yoga?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sure. I'm not an expert, but I can show
you the
right poses.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Thank you! I'll do my best to keep
up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Gold City proceeds to teach Kawakami
Princess
proper yoga.
